chunks.text:
All new employees at Northwind Robotics serve a **probation period of 90 calendar
days** from their start date. During probation, either party may end the
employment relationship with **7 days' written notice**.

Probation may be extended once, by up to 30 additional days, if the employee's
manager and an HR business partner both agree in writing. The employee must be
told of any extension before day 85.

Employees who complete probation successfully receive written confirmation and
become eligible for the full benefits package described in the Benefits and
Stipends policy.

Northwind Robotics uses a seven-level ladder shared across engineering, design,
operations, and go-to-market functions.

- **L1 – L2** — Associate. Works on well-defined tasks with regular guidance.
- **L3** — Professional. Owns defined problems end to end.
- **L4** — Senior. Owns ambiguous problems and mentors others.
- **L5** — Staff / Lead. Sets direction for a team or workstream.
- **L6** — Principal / Manager of managers. Sets direction across teams.
- **L7** — Distinguished / Director. Sets direction across the company.

Levels are internal and are not always reflected in external job titles.

not track hours worked for salaried employees; we track outcomes.

Employees are expected to be reachable during **core hours of 11:00–16:00 in
their registered home time zone**. Outside core hours, asynchronous
communication is the default and no one is expected to reply immediately.

Overtime pay applies only to employees classified as non-exempt under local law.
Non-exempt employees must record overtime in Workday before the end of the pay
period in which it was worked.

chunks.text:
Employees accrue **25 days of PTO per calendar year**, accruing monthly at 2.083
days per completed month of service. PTO covers vacation and personal days.

- PTO requests go through Workday and require manager approval.
- Requests of **5 consecutive days or more** must be submitted at least
  **21 days in advance**.
- Requests of fewer than 5 days should be submitted at least 3 days in advance
  where possible.
- You may carry over a maximum of **5 unused PTO days** into the next calendar
  year. Carried-over days expire on **31 March**.
- PTO does not need a stated reason. Managers may decline a specific date for
  business reasons but may not ask why you are taking it.

chunks.text:
Sick leave is **separate from PTO and does not come out of your PTO balance**.

Employees receive **10 paid sick days per calendar year**. Sick leave does not
carry over and is not paid out on termination.

- For absences of **1–2 consecutive days**, notify your manager by message
  before the start of your working day. No documentation is required.
- For absences of **3 or more consecutive days**, a medical certificate must be
  submitted to HR within 5 business days of returning.
- If sick leave is exhausted, further medical absence is handled under Extended
  Medical Leave (below), not under PTO.

Parental leave is available to all new parents regardless of gender, and applies
to birth, adoption, and long-term foster placement.

- Employees with **at least 12 months of service** receive **16 weeks of parental
  leave at 100% of base salary**.
- Employees with **less than 12 months of service** receive **8 weeks at 100% of
  base salary**.
- Leave must begin within 12 months of the birth or placement.
- It may be taken in up to **three separate blocks**, each at least 2 weeks long.
- Notify HR at least **30 days before** your intended start date where possible.

Parental leave does not reduce your PTO balance and continues to accrue PTO
normally.

chunks.text:
Northwind runs **one compensation review per year, effective 1 April**.

The cycle timeline:

- **January** — managers submit proposed adjustments.
- **February** — calibration across departments.
- **March** — outcomes communicated to employees individually.
- **1 April** — new salaries take effect, reflected in the April payslip.

Compensation review is **separate from the performance review cycle** and
separate from the promotion cycle. A strong performance review does not
automatically produce a salary increase, and a salary increase is not a
promotion.

Employees hired **after 1 October** are not included in the following April
cycle; their first review is the April after that.

chunks.text:
Promotions are considered **twice per year**, effective **1 April** and
**1 October**.

Promotion requires a written case from the employee's manager, evidence of
sustained performance at the next level, and approval at a cross-department
calibration meeting. Time in level is not by itself a qualification.

A promotion carries a salary adjustment to at least the minimum of the new
level's band. This adjustment is applied on the promotion's effective date and
is independent of the annual April compensation review.

Employees at L3 and above are eligible for an annual bonus, expressed as a
percentage of base salary and paid in the **March payslip** each year.

Target bonus by level:

| Job level | Target bonus |
| --------- | ------------ |
| L3        | 5%           |
| L4        | 10%          |
| L5        | 15%          |
| L6        | 20%          |
| L7        | 25%          |

The actual payout is the target multiplied by a company performance factor
(0 to 1.5) set by the board each January. Employees must be employed on the
payment date to receive the bonus. Employees who joined during the bonus year
receive a pro-rated amount based on completed months of service.

Every employee receives a **one-time home office setup stipend of 1,500 USD** on
joining, plus a **refresh of 500 USD every two years** thereafter.

Eligible purchases include a desk, an office chair, a monitor, a keyboard and
mouse, a desk lamp, and noise-cancelling headphones. Ergonomic equipment such as
a sit-stand desk or a supportive chair is explicitly encouraged.

Not eligible: consumables, decorative items, smart-home devices, furniture for
rooms other than the workspace, and any item primarily for personal use.

Equipment bought with the home office stipend belongs to the employee, not to
Northwind, and does not need to be returned when leaving.

Claims are submitted through Expensify with a receipt. No manager pre-approval
is needed if the item is on the eligible list.

Every employee receives a **learning stipend of 2,000 USD per calendar year** for
professional development.

Eligible: conference tickets and travel, online courses, professional
certifications, books, coaching, and language lessons relevant to your role.

- Claims **under 500 USD** need no pre-approval.
- Claims **of 500 USD or more** require written manager approval before purchase.
- Up to **1,000 USD** of unused learning stipend may be carried into the next
  calendar year; the carried amount expires 30 June.

Northwind also grants **5 learning days per year** — paid days for study,
courses, or conferences. Learning days are separate from PTO and do not reduce
your PTO balance. They do not carry over.

If Northwind pays for a certification costing more than 3,000 USD and the
employee leaves within 12 months, a pro-rated repayment may be required. This is
agreed in writing before the purchase, never applied retroactively.

Northwind Robotics supports three working arrangements. Your arrangement is
recorded in Workday and is agreed with your manager.

- **Office-based** — you work from a Northwind office at least 4 days per week.
- **Hybrid** — you work from a Northwind office **at least 2 days per week**,
  and remotely for the rest.
- **Fully remote** — you have no regular office attendance requirement.

Hybrid is the default for employees who live within 50 km of an office. Fully
remote is the default for everyone else.

legal entity. The current entity list is on the People wiki.

chunks.section: Equipment and Security for Remote Work
chunks.text:
Northwind provides a laptop to every employee. This is company property and must
be returned on leaving. It is **not** part of the home office stipend, which
covers furniture and peripherals only.

Remote workers must use the company VPN when accessing internal systems from
public networks, keep full-disk encryption enabled, and report a lost or stolen
device to `security@northwind-robotics.example` within 24 hours.

Personal devices may not be used to access customer data under any circumstances.

incurred. Claims older than 60 days require a written exception from a
department head and may be declined.

Reimbursements are paid with the **next monthly payroll run** for claims
approved at least 5 business days before the pay date.

chunks.text:
There are four routes for raising a concern. You may use any of them, in any
order, and you do not need to try one before another.

1. **Your manager** — appropriate for most day-to-day concerns.
2. **Any HR business partner** — directly, without involving your manager.
3. **The confidential reporting line** at
   `speakup@northwind-robotics.example`, monitored by two named senior HR staff.
4. **The independent external hotline**, operated by a third party. Reports here
   may be made anonymously. Details are on the People wiki and on posters in
   every office.

You never have to report a concern to the person it is about, or to anyone in
that person's reporting line.

chunks.text:
HR acknowledges every report **within 2 business days**.

For matters requiring investigation, an investigator with no involvement in the
matter is appointed within 5 business days. The person who raised the concern is
told the outcome, and the general nature of any action taken, within 30 days
where possible. If an investigation will take longer, they are told why.

Both the person raising a concern and the person it concerns may bring a
colleague or a support person to any meeting.

chunks.text:
Employees must declare anything that could reasonably look like a conflict of
interest, including:

- A close personal or family relationship with a colleague, particularly where
  one reports to the other, directly or indirectly.
- A financial interest in a customer, supplier, competitor, or partner beyond a
  holding in a broad-market fund.
- A relationship with a candidate you would be involved in hiring.
- Any outside role that touches Northwind's market.

Declarations go to `conduct@northwind-robotics.example` within **14 days** of
the situation arising. Declaring a conflict is not an admission of wrongdoing —
almost all declared conflicts are simply managed, usually by moving one person
out of a decision.
